verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              हीने परमके धर्मे सर्वलोकाभिसंहिते । सर्वस्मिन्दस्युसाद्भूते पृथिव्यामुपजीवने ॥१॥
verses.english: Janaka said O holy one, it has been said that the relation between male and female is like that which exists between the Indestructible and the Destructible.

verses.sanskrit: केन स्विद्ब्राह्मणो जीवेज्जघन्ये काल आगते । असंत्यजन्पुत्रपौत्राननुक्रोशात् पितामह ॥२॥

भीष्म उवाच।
              विज्ञानबलमास्थाय जीवितव्यं तथागते । सर्वं साध्वर्थमेवेदमसाध्वर्थं न किंचन ॥३॥
असाधुभ्योऽर्थमादाय साधुभ्यो यः प्रयच्छति । आत्मानं संक्रमं कृत्वा कृच्छ्रधर्मविदेव सः ॥४॥
आकाङ्क्षन्नात्मनो राज्यं राज्ये स्थितिमकोपयन् । अदत्तमेवाददीत दातुर्वित्तं ममेति च ॥५॥
विज्ञानबलपूतो यो वर्तते निन्दितेष्वपि । वृत्तिविज्ञानवान्धीरः कस्तं वा वक्तुमर्हति ॥६॥
येषां बलकृता वृत्तिस्तेषामन्या न रोचते । तेजसाऽभिप्रवर्तन्ते बलवन्तो युधिष्ठिर ॥७॥
यदैव प्राकृतं शास्त्रमविशेषेण वर्तते । तदैवमभ्यसेदेवं मेधावी वाऽप्यथोत्तरम् ॥८॥
ऋत्विक्पुरोहिताचार्यान् सत्कृतानभिसत्कृतान् । न ब्राह्मणान्घातयीत दोषान्प्राप्नोति घातयन् ॥९॥
verses.english: If Nature and Soul be always united together in this way by each opposing and cach depending on the other's qualities, I see, O holy one, that Liberation cannot exist. You, O holy one, are gifted with spiritual vision so that you see all things as if they are present before your eyes. If, therefore, there be any direct evidence of the existence of Liberation, do speak of it to me.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्प्रमाणं लोकस्य चक्षुरेतत्सनातनम् । तत्प्रमाणोऽवगाहेत तेन तत्साध्वसाधु वा ॥१०॥
verses.english: We are desirous of acquiring Liberation. Indeed, we wish to acquire That which is auspicious, bodiless, not subject to decrepitude, eternal, beyond the perception of the senses, and having nothing superior to it.

verses.sanskrit: बहवो ग्रामवास्तव्या रोषाद्ब्रूयुः परस्परम् । न तेषां वचनाद्राजा सत्कुर्याद्घातयीत वा ॥११॥
verses.english: Vashishtha said What you say about the characteristics of the Vedas and the other scriptures is even so. You understand those marks in the way in which they should be understood.

verses.sanskrit: न वाच्यः परिवादोऽयं न श्रोतव्यः कथञ्चन । कर्णावथापिधातव्यौ प्रस्थेयं चान्यतो भवेत् ॥१२॥
verses.english: O lord of kings, you only understand aright the texts of the Vedas and other scriptures without understanding the true senses or meaning of those texts, remembering them fruitlessly.

verses.sanskrit: असतां शीलमेतद्वै परिवादोऽथ पैशुनम् । गुणानामेव वक्तारः सन्तः सत्सु नराधिप ॥१३॥
verses.english: Indeed, one who remembers a work without understanding their meaning, is said to carry an useless load. He, however, who understands the true meaning of a treatise, is said to have studied that work to purpose.

verses.sanskrit: यथा सुमधुरौ दम्यौ सुदान्तौ साधुवाहिनौ । धुरमुद्यम्य वहतस्तथा वर्तेत वै नृपः ॥१४॥
verses.english: Asked about the meaning of a text, one should communicate that meaning which he has understood by a careful study.

verses.sanskrit: यथा यथाऽस्य बहवः सहायाः स्युस्तथा परे । आचारमेव मन्यन्ते गरीयो धर्मलक्षणम् ॥१५॥
verses.english: That person of dull intelligence who refuses to explain the meanings of text in the midst of an assemblage of the learned, that person of foolish understanding, never succeeds in explaining the meaning aright.

verses.sanskrit: अपरे नैवमिच्छन्ति ये शङ्खलिखितप्रियाः । मात्सर्यादथवा लोभान्न ब्रूयुर्वाक्यमीदृशम् ॥१६॥
verses.english: An ignorant wight, going to explain the true meaning of treatises, incurs ridicule. Even those endued with a knowledge of the Soul have to incurs ridicule on such occasions.

verses.sanskrit: आर्षमप्यत्र पश्यन्ति विकर्मस्थस्य पातनम् । न तादृक्सदृशं किञ्चित्प्रमाणं दृश्यते क्वचित् ॥१७॥
verses.english: Listen now to me, O king, as to how the subject of Liberation has been explained among the great persons conversant with the Sankhya and the Yoga Systems of Philosophy.

verses.sanskrit: देवताश्च विकर्मस्थं पातयन्ति नराधमम् । व्याजेन विन्दन्वित्तं हि धर्मात्स परिहीयते ॥१८॥
verses.english: That which the Yogins behold is exactly what the Sankhyas strive after to attain. He who sees the Sankhya and the Yoga Systems to be one and the same is said to be gifted with intelligence.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतः सत्कृतः सद्भिर्भूतिप्रवरकारणैः । हृदयेनाभ्यनुज्ञातो यो धर्मस्तं व्यवस्यति ॥१९॥
verses.english: Skin, flesh, blood, fat, bile, marrow, and sinews, and these senses, which you were speaking to me, exist.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चतुर्गुणसम्पन्नं धर्मं ब्रूयात् स धर्मवित् । अहेरिव हि धर्मस्व पदं दुःखं गवेषितुम् ॥२०॥
verses.english: Objects originate from objects; the senses from the senses. From body one acquires a body, as a seed is obtained from seed.

verses.sanskrit: यथा मृगस्य विद्धस्य पदमेकपदं नयेत् । लक्षेद्रुधिरलेपेन तथा धर्मपदं नयेत् ॥२१॥
verses.english: When the Supreme Being is without senses, without seed, without matter, without body, He must be divested of all qualities; and on account of His being so, how, indeed, can He have qualities of any kind?

verses.sanskrit: एवं सद्धिर्विनीतेन पथा गन्तव्यमित्युत । राजर्षीणां वृत्तमेतदेवं गच्छ युधिष्ठिर ॥२२॥
verses.english: Ether and other qualities originate from the qualities of Goodness, Darkness, and Ignorance, and disappear in the end in them. Thus the qualities arise from Nature and disappear in Nature.
